svg.aria-label: Retrieve invoices: collect, view and download Keep original invoices and faithful copies clearly identified.
svg.title: Retrieve invoices: collect, view and download Keep original invoices and faithful copies clearly identified.
svg.desc: Collect received invoices using existing onboarding access. Preserve each original or faithful copy with its source. The three Spain examples illustrate file roles; provider support remains unconfirmed.

g.text: Retrieve invoices: collect, view and download
Keep original invoices and faithful copies clearly identified.
Proposed design · Solid: collection steps · Dashed: applicable source or requested view/download
Read top to bottom. Both sources can apply to one invoice; link matching files before one product delivery.
Confirm access for the business or client
Reuse valid onboarding setup; check current permission
Find by presentation date; pull files (no webhook)
Collect invoices from the private platform
Read a notification or use supplied files
Download missing files; reuse complete supplied files
Save the files and collection results
Keep exact bytes, source, file role and receiving state
Only when every covered item is accounted for
Confirm recipient, safety, duplicates and business meaning
View the invoice or download a saved file
Show original / faithful copy / derived file
Deliver once and confirm product receipt
Show pending results, next action and owner
View and user download: required for public and private platforms. File labels keep original, faithful copy and derived roles separate.
A missing file or pending receiving handoff keeps collection progress incomplete. Show the next action and owner.
Mapping or product failure preserves safe permitted access. Source acknowledgement and buyer acceptance keep separate results.
Spain examples explain file roles only. Retrieval does not send invoices, select destinations or trigger public fallback.
Identify the original or faithful copy
Check the copy indicator and exchange evidence
Link both to one business invoice.
Original from SPFE; no faithful copy.
keep pending; do not reroute at retrieval.
Light teal: Customer settings · Light purple: Setup and checks · Grey notes: Spain examples; provider support unconfirmed
